messages:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — the onboarding splash image on /getting-started is 403ing from the CDN, reported by the nightly link scan :warning:
LinkBot: automated-scan detected 403 for https://cdn.redwood-inference.com/assets/onboarding/splash-v2.png (docs/getting-started/index.mdx) — scan-id=lnk-2026-03-18-01 :robot_face:
Kevin Blake: I can take this. do we have a replacement asset already? or should I re-upload the old one? :wave:
Maria Chen: there is a new asset in the bucket: s3://redwood-docs-prod/assets/onboarding/splash-v3.png — looks like the v2 file expired during a deploy. quick fix likely just swap the path in the MDX and redeploy CDN.
Alex Rivera: I can open a tiny PR for the path swap. sed to replace locally: `sed -i 's|/assets/onboarding/splash-v2.png|/assets/onboarding/splash-v3.png|g' docs/getting-started/index.mdx` then run `yarn docs:build` to sanity check.
Olivia Park: can we also add owner frontmatter to that page? e.g. `owner: @kevin` so future scans know who to ping.
Kevin Blake: putting together PR now. will also add `owner: @kevin` frontmatter and a one-liner in the PR description about the expired asset.
Kevin Blake: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1837 — small change, includes path swap + frontmatter + brief note. :eyes:
Alex Rivera: reviewing the PR, tiny nit on alt text for the image, will push one-line fix in review. :thumbsup:
LinkBot: re-scan queued for docs/getting-started/index.mdx after merge. I'll post status when it finishes.
Maria Chen: thanks everyone — once link-scan is green we can close. adding a quick regression note to the docs-runbook so this asset rotation is monitored. :white_check_mark:
